# arrives without a decision about it is red rather than invisible. `source` is
# either the reading the value is derived from (`derived`) or the reason it is a
# bound (`bound`); `unreviewed` is debt, not an answer, and its row count is capped
# in the test that reads this file. Regenerate with

column5: note
探测发行版镜像站可达性的墙：5s。
可达性探测的时限（与 shell 侧 `probe_reachable` 的 5s 对齐）。
kubespray 收尾后等节点注册的停顿：5s。

Floor for the background watermark. Below the speed the flusher threads can drain, the kernel starts writing back while the writers are still faster than it, so the queue this bound exists to shape never forms and the two points collapse i…
seconds of the device's own write allowed to pile before background writeback starts
Hard ceiling on either watermark, for a node whose RAM would put the share above it.
Floor for the force watermark, above the background floor by construction.
seconds of unflushed write before a writer is made to wait for its own writeback
a cap on the derived watermarks; keeps a fast device from holding the whole node's RAM dirty
装完 K3s 之后等 kubeconfig 能用的次数与间隔：30 × 2s = 60s。
the poll interval of the 30 x 2s wall above; short so a fast host does not wait on the probe
等全部节点 Ready 的次数与间隔：60 × 5s = 5 分钟。
the poll interval of the 60 x 5s wall above; long enough for one image layer to land
最佳努力的新版本探测单次上限。
集群内 registry 播种基镜像失败后的重试间隔。
How long a retirement waits for the consumer to end.

Wall for the one command this crate runs on a checkout to produce a change's text. The work is a git diff over a working tree, so two minutes is sized for a large tree being scanned, not for a slow computation.

Wall for the one extra model call that reshapes a thought into the JSON the squad protocol reads. It is a single short completion, so it is held to a fraction of a turn: a slow upstream should cost this fallback, not the run.

Wall for assembling the run's final result at the end of the loop. This is bookkeeping the run already has the material for, so it is generous only to cover a large artifact being rendered — a run that spends this long has wedged rather th…
one turn's share: long enough to store a payload, short enough not to wedge the turn
How many pending messages one reclaim call asks for.
safety threshold so a still-draining process is not robbed; nothing waits on it

a tool result is re-sent on every turn after it arrives, so this bounds what those later turns pay rather than whether the window has room for it; 32K characters is the read page's own size because a page read back and a command printed out occupy the same place in the conversation
policy split: half the window is kept for task input and later turns

the low-water mark the trim cuts to, not the budget it cuts from: cutting to exactly the budget drops one entry every turn and slides the cached prefix forever, so the cut goes to half and the same cut returns a half window later
Default capacity of the engine's input channel.
identical events inside one second run one action; cog-core's dedup_window_secs default spells the same 1
a default wait for one hook action; cog-core's hook_timeout_secs and HookDef::timeout() spell the same 30
how far back the ceiling looks; older runs describe another workload
a batching choice; the flush deadline is what bounds the wait
flush deadline for buffered events; the batch size of 16 is the other half of the batching

How often this agent says it is alive to the control plane. Short enough that a restarted control plane re-learns its agents without a redeploy, long enough that the heartbeat is not the busiest thing on the channel.
How often the container's memory is re-read against the count in force.
sits just above the 0.70-0.72 baseline measured on the main pod on 2026-10-24
one decision below the chart's 0.81 near-limit alert, so the alert reports a failure
a default wait inside a turn, long enough for a peer's run and no longer
the cap that keeps a peer's silence from becoming an unbounded wait
roughly the payload a tool result carries when it still fits a turn
an order of magnitude above the WASM bound because the thing timed is a build, which is expected to take minutes.

Default wall for one WASM tool call. The guest is somebody else's code: a module that never returns has to come back to the caller as a failure, so the bound is short — a compute-shaped tool that legitimately needs longer asks for it inste…
one turn's share: enough for a bounded payload, short enough not to wedge the turn

a page, not a budget: the caller named no limit and the file is longer than this, so it gets this many lines plus has_more and next_offset. Sized so a common source file still reads in one call while a whole-file dump becomes pages — every following turn re-sends this text, so one unpaged read spends the prefix-cache share of the rest of the conversation.

the second bound on the same page, because a line count is not a size: a minified JSON or one very long log line reaches 600 lines with a megabyte behind it. A page stops at whichever bound is tighter, and a single line over this budget is returned alone so next_offset still advances.
Characters of extracted text returned when the caller does not ask for a size. Roughly one long article; the caller can raise it for a document it means to read whole.

Hits returned when the caller does not say how many it wants. Ten is one screen of titles and excerpts: enough to choose a page to read, small enough that a turn is not spent on links it will not follow.
a page that has not started answering by then will not make the turn useful

Bytes one page may transfer. Below the point where a single turn is worth anything, the page cannot be read anyway; above it, an accidental video or an infinite stream costs the pod's memory before extraction ever runs.
past this the answer is a document, and a document belongs in the archive
ceiling on hits; every hit is context every later turn pays for
How many times a page the backend failed on is asked for again.
room for a browser to start, run scripts and settle; the fetch deadline is too short
How many times a search whose engines all stayed silent is asked again.
the point past which the slowest metasearch engine is not worth the turn
默认的 JWKS 缓存时长：1 小时。
how long a fetched key set is reused; bounds how long a rotated-away key is still accepted
Session TTL in seconds (7 days).
twice the largest TokenBudget threshold the shipped configurations declare (100000 in all three carriers); the estimator saturates here, and a gate test keeps every declared threshold below it
the first repair is what lets feedback be acted on at all, the second absorbs a first rewrite that was itself rejected; past that the feedback is unchanged, so repeating it cannot buy another outcome
declared file count at which a change is too big for the lightest topology — one above the shortcut's ceiling of 3
declared diff size at which a change is too big for the lightest topology; three times the shortcut's 40 leaves a band where declared size alone does not decide
design rule with nothing measured yet: score below it takes the cheaper decomposition, and on the boundary the roundtable wins because the decision is uncertain
files a request may name and still be the shortcut's own work
diff lines an attached change may declare and still be the shortcut's own work
连续 Pipeline 失败多少次后自动升级到 Roundtable 模式。
ceiling on the paced backoff so a paused squad is not silent longer than a minute; the known cost of the last paced round is recorded above it rather than folded into the number
cargo's profile level, then the deps/incremental level that can be dropped
a 5 GiB claim less the co-tenants measured by hand; the auto cap can replace it
series cap; everything past it is folded into one other series by size
floor; a metadata walk over hundreds of thousands of entries gains nothing fresher
an hour, matching the hand readings on record and the length of a real build
headroom over the measured peak so the next repeat build is not instantly over cap
How long a working-set peak stands when no walk re-reaches it.
shared cadence while every walker keeps a fixed period; the sandbox executor's volume walk now takes it as the floor and paces above it
no fresher than the 30s scrape interval; a cheap metadata walk gains nothing
the token lifetime's default; cog-auth's JwtConfig::default spells the same 15 separately
hourly against a 24h Gitee token, leaving room for several failed renewals
Renew once under 4h of lifetime remain: enough for the token exchange, the Secret patch and the gateway roll to all land before expiry.
one window shared by the ready sweeper and the publisher's stall check
the budget is where a call must return an error, not a latency target; the driver default costs 473 s against a refused address
retry attempts within that budget; the callers that can tolerate redis being away already retry the whole operation, and they need the failure to come back to them rather than be absorbed here
per-consumer quiet period: one round trip when idle, prompt wake when not
a drain read; the entries it waits for are already in the stream
the point past which a reply is lost rather than late, not a latency target; left unset the wait is the kernel's, measured at ten minutes
three renewal ticks at lease/3, so two may be missed before another process judges it gone
below it a momentary refusal would be reported as a permanent error
below it the timeout races the round trip itself
character ceiling because names come from the document and multiply the length
names spelled out before the rest are counted; keeps one alert row readable
long enough for a path or an upstream message to survive truncation, short enough that a label value stays a label value
Files kept in every layer, whatever the cap.
The rank of a layer neither list places, which is the last of them.

Rows kept per receiving peer, so a chatty sender cannot grow the table without bound. Larger than what a panel shows at once, because how far back a reader can scroll and what fits on one screen answer different questions.
Rows kept per session: two per turn, so a hundred user/assistant pairs.
depth at which a bounded event stream pushes back; a default, not a measured queue length
ten minutes covers a build or a long model call and still shows a stopped owner inside the same working session
fifteen minutes is enough for the two parties to finish the move they signed, short enough that a signature nobody applied is visible inside the same session
没写 `timeout_ms` 的钩子跑多久：30s。
matches the ceiling the gateway's circuit breaker advertises, so a recovered wait cannot outlast the source that produced it.
the multiple the deployed stall rule measures a loop against; the rule adds the loop's declared work budget on top.
The one scale importance is expressed on, system-wide: a rating in `1..=IMPORTANCE_RATING_MAX`, divided by the maximum.
with the timestamp and random segments alongside it the whole raw id stays far below NAME_MAX, while the prefix still shows where an entry came from
The longest a loop may take between two asks of the arbiter, and the term it holds a role for once one is answered.
three ask periods (ASK_PERIOD), so a renewal lost to a slow query or a restart does not cost the holder its role.
past six characters a trailing .foo reads as a sentence fragment rather than a file type
one letter is the shape of an abbreviation (e.g, i.e), not of a file type anybody ships
How many hex digits cargo appends to a binary name's stem: sixteen, the truncated metadata hash.
How many panic sites a digest names. A run can panic in every test it has; the first few name the places to look, and the rest is repetition that would spend the budget the failing-test list needs.
Default high watermark: when the buffer reaches this level, the producer pauses.
Default low watermark: when the buffer drops below this level, the producer resumes.
默认每小时扫一次分层：分层是按时间的判据，密到分钟级只会重复搬同一批对象。

The damping constant of reciprocal rank fusion as the literature defines it (k = 60): it holds the weight of the lowest ranks near the weight of the highest instead of letting one list's top hit decide the fusion.
a judgement is made against a handful of artifacts; a longer list is a corpus, and a corpus belongs on the material side where it can be paged
fits a URI with a query string, not a document in the field whose job is to point at one
a subject line; over-length is refused at submission rather than truncated, because a cut subject is the submitter's words with the reason removed
these fields are inlined into the goal and copied into every later change, so the bound is on the submission, not on the row as stored
the ceiling before any git command here has completed; only this is available
multiple of the slowest git command that has completed; the corpse age is twice it

a declared reference point, not a dial: three writers stamp under it and every reader's alert window has to be longer than it, which is a relation between two settings that nothing can check if both can move; the alert-rule contract test in cogneva reads the gateway's name to check the window
非 CJK 字符每多少个算一个 token（英文约 4 字符 1 token）。
一个英文词的代价，也是任何一个词的下限。
at most five test names in a verdict; the rest are counted, not listed
重新算一次界的最小间隔：60s。
floor before a median is this workload's history rather than noise
判定「这一例偏慢」的倍数：比自己的历史中位数慢这么多倍才算红灯。
可用内存的地板，低于它减半。
绿灯的可用内存线：高于它才加一。
绿灯：PSI 三项的 `avg60` 全在这条线以下才加一。
红灯：PSI 任一项的 `avg10` 越过这个百分比就减半。
未实测的上界：4，取的是驱动原先写死的并发数。
未实测的下界：1，只是「不许是零」的形式下界。
a gate two orders above normal call density; it only bites in a refusal storm
floor when a refusal states no wait; three orders above the measured 0.7ms fast failure
above the ~4min window flip seen and below a 45min pod's life; past it the call is refused, not waited
「每分钟 N 次」里的一分钟就是窗口长度。
默认给外部流派几个核：2。
默认给外部流派多少内存：4 GiB。
一次外部流派评测的默认墙钟：10 分钟。
默认的上下文窗口：512K tokens。
below this a `data:` string is prose mentioning the word, not an attachment
presentation geometry: the whitespace that keeps axis labels from meeting the curve.
presentation geometry: the canvas height at which a curve and its readings are legible at a glance.
画布尺寸与留白。这是呈现面的几何：选的是一条曲线与它前后的读数能一眼看清， 不是从数据里量出来的量，也没有别的代码依赖这几个数。
default cadence; the shared floor is applied where the interval is read
Port the executor listens on when `SANDBOX_EXECUTOR_PORT` names none.

Wall for a command whose caller named none. Long enough for an interactive command to finish, short enough that a caller which stopped listening does not hold the executor; a caller that needs longer asks for it, up to the ceiling above.
Hard ceiling on command duration regardless of what the client asks for.
one working day; a plan unread longer is no longer the plan about to be read

Default for the body of one host document. Sized for the largest document this platform writes by hand (a plan or an audit), not to the channel's bound: a document is stored whole, so the number answers to what a reader can open.
past a few thousand entries the listing costs more than it tells either reader

A full-size body. **Deliberately not tied to the audited channel's bound**: that one is another process's quantity, bounding the text one request sends out, while this one bounds the bytes this process reads into memory. That the two value…
below this the plan could expire between being displayed and clicked
a couple of kilobytes name the file; the call costs more with every byte
past a few dozen files the rule table, not the files, is the subject
long enough for a slow upstream, short enough not to hang on a silent channel
连远端运行时（沙盒执行器）的墙：10s。
seed; applies only until the first observed move of main, then the fetch period follows that
seed; applies only until a reclamation pass has been timed, then the interval follows the pass
policy ceiling when the deployment names none; the disk measurement can still lower it
seed; applies only until two trees exist to give an arrival interval
one over the share of the process upkeep may take, times the pass; shared by reclamation and the cache walk
a directory-name limit, not a capacity of this machine
below this every fetch asks for the same commit
floor under the pass-duration derivation; also the pace the loop wakes and beats at
floor under the arrival-rate derivation, before two trees exist
room the git commands writing while the cap is reached need
the A2A specification's default page_size when the caller names none
the A2A specification's page_size ceiling
one default page of conversation lines; the store keeps far more and the caller may ask for it
longest a request may hold a connection waiting for an agent's answer, set below the idle bound of the proxies in front
failed attempts per identifier inside the window before the endpoint answers 429
the sliding window the failed-attempt count is kept in, so an attacker's budget is per five minutes
下载时一次读多少字节。它乘上并发下载数就是这一面可能吃掉的峰值内存，所以定成声明而不是留在读循环里的字面量。
导出包口令的最短长度。这不是安全强度而是「别让 `123456` 变成一份密文包的钥匙」——包里是整库数据，会被复制、被带走。
intent classification is a one-word answer; past this the backend is struggling and the plain chat path takes over
connecting is fast or the backend is the problem, and the failover pool is what handles a slow one
how many turns fit in one request, not how many are stored — the record is trimmed by its own bound in the store
matches the upstream's own in-stream cap; only an idle gap beyond it aborts a reasoning turn

The loop that makes a dead cluster read alertable. A narrowed grant lasts hours, so this answers within one scrape-to-alert cycle; each cycle is one `limit=1` read per resource, so going faster would trade against nothing. The stall rule reads this number as the declared period, so moving it moves what counts as a stalled probe.
每个节点上都有一个 claim-store，它走查节点存储根，把每个卷的真实字节数发布在 `/metrics` 上。这一面直接读那些端点：声明写了多大、盘上真的占了多少，两个数 并排才是「资源账本」。
Default for the auditable request-body bound: 8 MiB.
each listed report costs one body read to name its dataset, so the cap bounds the reads; the untrimmed total is reported so the caller sees a prefix
这一面一次要多少行。窗口本身比较浅，这个数比窗口大，意思是「把整个窗口都给我」，
演进事件流的保活间隔：15s。
登记部署密钥那次调用（GitHub API）的单次上限：15s。
SSH 自证握手的硬超时。与选路探测同量级（那是一条 `ls-remote` 的一次往返）， 但要留出"密钥被接受、仓库可读"这一段真实往返的余量。
total wall for one clone/fetch/push; the stall judgement cannot catch a remote that keeps printing progress and never ends
silence that marks a transfer dead; --progress writes at second granularity, so silence is no progress, while a slow link still makes progress
HTTPS 快路径的等待上限。GET 是 `info/refs`（应答小、上游立刻回）；POST 是 pack 计算 + 传输，给足时间。**这两个值判的是"是不是进了黑洞"，不是给正常 请求设预算**——透传路径原本没有任何总超时，加它就是为了让降级判据存在。
post 的判据与 get 同形，只是量级不同：一次 post 要把整包算完再传出去， 所以在正常仓库上它本来就以分钟计；这个界判的仍是「是不是进了黑洞」。
base of the circuit-breaker probe backoff: consecutive failures retreat exponentially from this cadence
镜像单次响应体上限，与透传路径的 256MB 缓冲约定一致。
a mirror's last successful fetch must be this recent to serve as a baseline; the same number is the oldest a fallback baseline may be
lowest the deployment may set the operation timeout to; below it a large legitimate fetch is cut
lowest the deployment may set the stall judgement to, so a healthy transfer is never killed for being quiet
看门狗巡检间隔的上限；实际间隔按静默窗的四分之一取（见 [`GitTransport::watchdog_interval`]），这样测试里把窗口压到秒级仍然判得准。
巡检间隔的下限：静默窗压到毫秒级（测试）时，别让巡检变成忙等。
newer residue may belong to a live transfer (progress updates by the second, locks live less than a request); only clearly stale files are a dead process's
失败信息里保留的 stderr 尾巴长度：传输失败的**原因在最后几行**，而前几千行
超时后等被杀的进程/读取任务收尾的上限。杀的是整个进程组，正常情况下管道 立刻断开；给个上限只为不让"已判定超时"的路径自己再挂住。
probe budget for one channel's handshake, not a channel's request budget — exceeding it means the channel is unavailable now
how long a measured channel verdict stands: longer than the circuit-breaker probe cadence, short enough that a torn-down wall shows within minutes
one network-profile signal probe, at the same order as the bootstrap's short probes: reachable, not how fast
an installation token lives about an hour; this caches ten minutes short of that.
issued-at is backdated by a minute so clock drift against GitHub cannot make the token not-yet-valid
GitHub's hard ceiling on an App JWT is ten minutes; this sits a minute under it.
installation token is refreshed this long before its expiry, so a request never carries one about to lapse
one page of outstanding rows; the total comes from the census, not from the page
refused principles returned by one read; both totals are taken before the truncation, so the page never doubles as the count
rows read to compute the totals, bounded by how many principles one deployment could ever have refused
widest history a caller may ask for in one read
moves returned by one history; they come newest first, so the bound drops the oldest and the question is how this got here
prefix examined before a file is called binary, and the same files are never returned in full
一个工作区默认能占多少字节：一份源码加它自己的构建产物的量级， 不是一个按租户量出来的容量，所以它是个部署可改的默认值。
单个文件的上限。编辑器不是上传通道：超过这个量的东西该走附件那条路。
one directory listing; a tree of millions of files must not fill a response
流式读 `git show` 管道时一次拿多少字节：块越大系统调用越少，但要小到一次读不把这一页用不上的部分也搬进内存；64 KiB 落在这一对之间，且与文件大小无关，所以不随 MAX_FILE_BYTES 变
matches returned when the caller names no limit
一次搜索最多读多少字节：与上面的文件数同一个界的字节侧，定在扫一份仓库的文本 仍能在一次请求里答完的位置。
search answers synchronously, so it walks a bounded number of files before it stops looking
widest page of matches a caller may ask for
上传 / 下载的上限。比编辑器那条宽——整份构建产物、一张截图也该能搬进搬出， 但必须落在路由层请求体的封顶之下并留出余量：超过那条线的大请求在到达这里 之前就被拒，本层再给一个更大的数只会让两边说法不一致。
widest answer assembled over HTTP rather than an internal candidate window; the same ceiling the wiki search applies
零凭证的集群内面：只挂 Pod 侧要走的 memory 路由，不挂认证/会话/配额。
上游能力探测单次最多等多久。
协议形态探测（anthropic / openai 两种线格式）单次上限。
a listing costs one store read per id, so the cap bounds the reads; the untrimmed total is reported so a prefix is visible
lifetime of the signed URL for stored bytes: long enough for the request that asked, short enough that a working link does not circulate
the cluster verdict only asks whether anything fires, so one row settles it however much is firing
Cap on the trailing window one request may ask for.
重试上限拍数：与下面的拍长合成约 30s 的窗口，够两个 Deployment 滚动完；不无限等是因为等不到时留在活档上的是默认的 auto，无限等就等于永远不报「没恢复」
读回流策略的重试拍长：网关可能比本进程晚几十秒才应答，更短只是空转，更长则属主设的 local/ask 更久地停在默认的 auto 上
two report intervals: a container that stopped stops reporting, and its last table must not keep reading as the current one
process names are short; the long string is the command line, which this face does not read
a report is a shape, not a stream: beyond this the list is not something a reader reads, and the receiver caps so a caller cannot grow the store by reporting
this face names what an unclaimed container is doing rather than listing it: four distinct names identify one container, and the reader gets a single line per container
一轮之间隔多久。
调用方 id 的桶到这个数就先扫一遍过期的。桶是每个调用方一格，不扫就是一处随调用方数量无界增长的内存；扫早了只是白扫，扫晚了峰值内存跟着人数长。
每调用方每分钟的读预算，可由 `COGNEVA_PROJECT_READ_PER_MIN` 覆盖。一个正常刷新的看板每分钟十几次，600 是它的几十倍——够任何真人用，也够挡住一个卡在刷新循环里的页面；它不是从机器测量导出的，是从「一个人一分钟会看几次」定出来的界。
看板一列最多画多少张卡。列里永远带全量计数与 `cards_hidden`，所以这个上限只截清单、不截读数；取 100 是因为一屏能翻完的卡片数在这个量级，再多也只是把滚动条拉长。
项目名/任务标题的字符上限。它不是排版数字而是输入校验的界：没有上限时一条把整个文档贴进标题的请求会进到每一个读面（看板、甘特、导出）的每一行里。
不传 `limit` 时一页返回多少个项目。与 `PROJECTS_PAGE_MAX` 成对：默认值小到一屏能读完，大请求才要显式说要。
一页的上限。存在的理由是拒绝比静默截断更便宜：读全量要带游标一页页走，而不是把 `limit` 调成一百万让这一次请求把整张图读进内存。
范围树的展开深度上限，防的是 `parent_task_id` 上的环把树折成无穷。正常范围树的深度是个位数量级，256 只是「这里一定有环」的那道墙。
a reading that cannot answer in five seconds is already the answer; a failed query reads as no reading and never as zero
one git action on a small local repository; slower than a poll cycle means it is wedged
日志默认与最多回多少条。
most log rows returned
changes returned by one status read
一次 diff 最多回多少字节、多少行。
keeps a pathological line count from filling the byte cap with tiny lines; the byte cap is the primary bound

What one pass may retire: the batch is counted in task streams, not rows, because a stream is retired whole or not at all -- a deleted prefix reads to both replayers exactly like the start of a run. Five hundred is the event log's batch: streams are bounded by how many tasks ran, not by how many turns they took, so the reach is a fraction of the archive whatever its size, and each batch beats the loop's heartbeat so a long pass does not read as a stalled one.

Days of silence after which a task's stream is retired. Measured on 2026-10-27: 130,871 events over 34 days came to 211 MB across 8,121 streams, and the longest run still appending was 34 days old -- so age alone cannot decide, and the cutoff bounds quietness rather than age: a run that appended inside the window is kept in full no matter how old it is. Thirty days answers an audit question about last month; the loop publishes whatever it was told as cogneva_task_events_keep_seconds, so the rule's bound moves with this number instead of being one of its own.

The shortest retention this loop will honour. A zero or negative day count would make every stream quiet the moment it paused, which reads as a retention that works while the archive it bounds stays empty by construction -- a value below this falls back to the default rather than being obeyed.

Two minutes, half of Prometheus's five-minute staleness window, so the size series survives a pass that finds nothing to retire. The archive's age moves in days; a faster pass would only restate it more often.
